q: The Shilnikov condition for a homoclinic orbit to a saddle-focus equilibrium in ℝ³ (eigenvalues −ρ ± iω, λ with ρ,ω,λ > 0) leads to chaos if:
exp: Shilnikov's theorem: if λ > ρ (the real positive eigenvalue exceeds the magnitude of the real part of the complex eigenvalues), then near the homoclinic orbit there are infinitely many periodic orbits with horseshoe dynamics—Shilnikov chaos.
